data.body:
LANDED. Gerrit change 1261 merged at 2026-08-03 03:11:38 UTC as commit 442a4d9409 on main
("Make DC comment ceiling configurable"), after LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 with zero
unresolved comments and no recheck needed (first CI run passed). Verified by
git fetch gerrit main: 442a4d9409 carries all four files (src/rebar/_config_schema.py,
adapters/jira_datacenter/settings.py, adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py, and the new
tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_dc_comment_ceiling_049e.py), 280 insertions / 25 deletions.
The GitHub mirror may lag; the Gerrit ref is authoritative.

All five acceptance criteria are satisfied — see the preceding IMPLEMENTATION EVIDENCE comment
for the per-AC detail, the RED-first message, and the two mutation verdicts. The one deviation
worth an operator's attention is AC3: the readability of /rest/api/2/application-properties was
determined DOCUMENTARILY (admin-only) rather than by a live 403 from rebar's own PAT, because
the amd64-only DC harness cannot be brought up on this arm64 host; discovery is dropped either
way, which is the outcome the AC permits. The only follow-up left is a one-row addition to
docs/config.md for [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars, deliberately skipped here because
that file was outside this change's file ownership.

This ticket is intentionally left in_progress for the operator to close.
